question: Should OpenClaw bundle a 1Password resolver that passes credential environment to an operator-provided `op` binary and performs one parallel CLI read per SecretRef id?
rationale: CI cannot decide whether OpenClaw should own this external executable trust boundary or accept its request-amplification behavior, especially while the related rate-limit issue remains open.

options.title: Mitigate before bundling
options.body: Bound or batch CLI reads, document the executable trust model, and obtain exact-head security approval before merge.

options.title: Accept current boundary
options.body: Explicitly accept per-id parallel reads and the operator-provided CLI credential boundary with documented operational limits.

options.title: Keep it external
options.body: Publish the integration outside core until maintainers approve a bundled security and availability contract.

recommendation.title: Mitigate before bundling
recommendation.body: Bound or batch CLI reads, document the executable trust model, and obtain exact-head security approval before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The external-secrets history and security ownership make this the strongest available routing candidate for the permanent trust-boundary decision.
